summary_1line: Krishna and Arjuna worship Shiva, obtain his celestial bow and arrow guarded as serpents, and seek the formidable Pasupata weapon.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna and Arjuna stand with folded hands before the three‑eyed Shiva while sages and fragrant smoke surround the god holding the bow Pinaka.
At a radiant celestial lake, a thousand‑headed serpent blazing with fire rises from the water before Krishna and Arjuna.
Two terrible serpents transform into a shining bow and arrow as the heroes chant Vedic hymns beside the glowing lake.
